primary_claim: In Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the internal difference-of-means 'eval-awareness' direction is a genuine detector of evaluation framing (~0.81 AUROC on novel format-matched framings) but steering with it does not causally drive sandbagging (flat dose-response that fails to beat an empirical null of 24 random directions) nor predict which individual items get sandbagged (per-item probe AUROC ~0.54, at chance).

effect.metric: swing in sandbagging accuracy from steering dose alpha=-2 to alpha=+2 at headline layer 12, vs empirical null of 24 random directions
effect.value: -1.77pp swing, sub-threshold Spearman rho=-0.53 (p=0.08), does not beat empirical null (p=0.20)

contradicts_or_qualifies: qualifies the hope that the eval-awareness representation is linear and steerable, so it could be used to both detect and suppress sandbagging by nullifying the direction; only the detection half holds
stated_future_work: push steering to +/-3 or +/-4 at layer 12, up to the coherence boundary, to settle whether the causal null persists
test more organisms and password-locked settings: a fine-tuned/password-locked sandbagger and an adversarial organism
explore SAE features rather than a simple difference-of-means direction, since the concept might be more spread out
test other <=8B models to see if the marker-overfit observation at later layers generalizes
limitations_stated: these results are still somewhat preliminary: a single 8B model, a single prompted organism, no SAE, and a steering dose that may be too gentle for general conclusions
the steering was rather gentle; the KL divergence at alpha=+/-2 was ~0.001, meaning the model barely moved, so we could have probably pushed harder
the ground-truth label sources (honest baseline gap and noise-injection oracle) agree on only about 54% of items, meaning which item is being sandbagged is not a well-defined per-item quantity
quote: I found that direction is a valid detector of evaluation framing (~0.81 AUROC under novel, format matched framings) but is neither a causal drive of sandbagging nor a per-item predictor of it.
